answer: Our pricing plans start at $49/month (Basic), $99/month (Professional), and custom pricing for Enterprise. Visit our website's pricing page for full details and a feature comparison.

We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all plans. Cancellations can be processed through your account settings under Billing, or by contacting our support team directly.
We provide REST APIs, webhooks, and official SDKs for JavaScript, Python, and Go. Full API documentation and integration guides are available at docs.yourcompany.com.
